subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this stale token-meter branch be rebased into the current freshness-aware chat composer as a separate base meter, or closed/superseded by the existing context usage control?
rationale: The patch is a user-facing UX feature on a protected maintainer-labeled PR, and current main already has a related context usage control with stricter stale-token behavior.

options.title: Rebase and share context model
options.body: Move the meter onto the current chat composer and drive it from getContextNoticeViewModel or the same freshness contract before merge.

options.title: Treat current context control as enough
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers decide the existing ring/popover context usage UI covers the Sprint 2 need.

options.title: Accept a separate stale-aware meter
options.body: Keep the base meter as a distinct UX element, but make stale totals hidden or visibly updating with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Rebase and share context model
recommendation.body: Move the meter onto the current chat composer and drive it from getContextNoticeViewModel or the same freshness contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has prior ownership of the web context usage UI and is also the member author of this protected UX branch.
